target.definition: Total milk production in the 24 major U.S. states during September 2026, as first reported by USDA NASS in the monthly Milk Production report.

inputs.name: us_milk_production_annual
inputs.description: Total annual U.S. milk production (all states) in a recent year

provenance.rationale: US annual milk production has been around 225-230 billion lb in recent years

inputs.name: major24_share_of_us
inputs.description: Share of U.S. milk production coming from the 24 major states

provenance.rationale: The 24 major states account for nearly all U.S. milk output

inputs.name: september_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of annual production occurring in September

provenance.rationale: September is 1/12 of the year with slight seasonal variation

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for U.S. milk production from 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Milk production has been roughly flat with small growth

inputs.name: dairy_cows_major24
inputs.description: Average number of milk cows in the 24 major states during September 2026

provenance.rationale: U.S. milk cow herd is about 9.3-9.4 million head, with the 24 major states holding most of it

inputs.name: milk_per_cow_per_day
inputs.description: Average daily milk yield per milk cow in the 24 major states

provenance.rationale: U.S. average milk per cow is roughly 64-66 lb/day

inputs.name: milk_consumed_per_person_per_day
inputs.description: Average daily per-capita consumption of fluid milk and dairy milk-equivalent in the U.S.

provenance.rationale: Per-capita dairy consumption is roughly 1.5 lb milk-equivalent per day

inputs.name: production_to_consumption_ratio
inputs.description: Ratio of total U.S. milk production to domestic milk-equivalent consumption

provenance.rationale: The U.S. produces somewhat more milk than it consumes domestically, with exports

inputs.name: september_share_of_year_proxy
inputs.description: Fraction of annual production in September used in the proxy path

provenance.rationale: Same seasonal share as top-down path

paths.description: Scale annual U.S. production by major-24 share, September share, and growth
Count cows in the 24 major states times daily yield times days in September
Scale from U.S. population consumption times production-to-consumption ratio, major-24 share, and September share
paths.formula: us_population * milk_consumed_per_person_per_day * production_to_consumption_ratio * major24_share_of_us * september_share_of_year_proxy * days_in_september
